metadata.title: Casse-Croûte chez Ti-Pit — Poutine & burgers in Val-d'Or
metadata.description: Pepper poutine, quarter-pound burgers and homemade fries in Val-d'Or. Sunny terrace, dine-in or takeout. Call (819) 825-1517.
